Docs.summary: Provides calendar systems, dates, date-times, periods, and eras for ISO and non-ISO calendars.

remarks.para: defines a calendar system. defines a date in that system. This namespace includes the Hijrah, Japanese, Minguo, Thai Buddhist, and ISO calendar systems.

Use the ISO-based types in Java.Time for most application logic, data storage, and network transfers. Use the calendar-specific types when the user interface must accept or display dates in another calendar system. Read the guidance for before using multiple calendar systems.

format.a: Java reference for the java.time.chrono package.
